title: An operation deadline cancels an active hedge race
requirement: After an alternate-region hedge is dispatched, a transient primary followed by an operation deadline while the alternate remains pending returns a client timeout with both regions, applied faults, and cancelled-awaiting-partner state retained in diagnostics.

precedents.test: primary transient awaiting secondary deadline branch

azureLive.reason: The scenario uses deterministic regional fault injection to hold both hedge legs across the operation deadline.
